go_no_go: GO — Production deployment is approved. The 2 issues below are non-blocking (cosmetic React warning + WS browser handshake warning with working REST fallback).

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard / Reports / History (any page rendering trip rows)
ui_bugs.issue: React console error 'Encountered two children with the same key, null' is STILL present (already flagged in iteration_8). Indicates a .map() somewhere is using a field that can be null as React key. Likely in DashboardPage trips table or driver list. Not visible to users but cause data duplication risks in future.

Browser warning 'WebSocket connection to wss://.../api/livre/realtime failed: WebSocket is closed before the connection is established'. Pytest WS suite passes (backend confirmed working). Likely the browser hook attempts to connect before the auth cookie/session is ready (on login page) or the ingress drops the first handshake. The exponential-backoff reconnect eventually succeeds — Conflict Inbox bell shows correct unresolved count via fallback, so user-visible impact is minimal. Worth investigating: gate connect() until /auth/me succeeds.
